title: A.A.R.M
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Dwight becomes the permanent manager and enforces new security measures while the office prepares for a documentary airing. Jim and Dwight conduct humorous tests to select an assistant to the assistant to the regional manager, ultimately appointing Dwight himself. Andy and Casey compete in an a cappella audition, with Andy later performing an emotional but rejected audition. Angela moves in with Oscar after her divorce, and Dwight discovers that Phillip is his son, leading to a heartfelt proposal to Angela. The office gathers at Poor Richard's bar to watch the documentary about their company.

main_threads.thread: Dwight's new role as permanent manager and his security measures, including his interactions with Phillip and his proposal to Angela.
